test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following ports is **NOT** located on the Eastern Coast of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kandla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kandla, currently officially known as the Deendayal Port Authority,** is a seaport and town in Gujarat's Kutch district, close to Gandhidham.
 
• It is one of India's major west coast ports, located on the** Gulf of Kutch.**
 
• It's roughly 256 nautical miles southeast of Pakistan's Karachi Port and 430 nautical miles north-northwest of Mumbai's Port.
 
• Kandla Port was built in the 1950s to serve as the main seaport for western India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Between the Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal lies the **Eastern Coastal Plains**, a large area of Indian territory.
 
• **Paradip Port **is a natural, deep-water port on India's east coast, located in Paradip, Odisha, about 53 kilometres from Jagatsinghpur city.
 
• **V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority, formerly called Tuticorin Port Trust**, is a port in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, and is one of the 13 major ports in India. It was declared to be a major port on 11 July 1974. It is the second largest port in Tamil Nadu and third-largest container terminal in India. V.O. Chidambaranar Port is an artificial port.
 
• **Haldia port** or **Haldia Dock Complex **has been built at the meeting place of the Haldi River and Hooghly river. Kolkata Port Trust has been created in this port as the port's partner. So it is not a port. It is an official dock complex.
